description: This file defines the LocationEditor class which serializes and deserializes Location objects for web forms, enabling retrieval by ID and UUID within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: LocationEditor
classes.description: A property editor for Location objects that supports conversion from string IDs or UUIDs to Location instances.

methods.name: getObjectById(Integer id)
methods.description: Retrieves a Location object based on its integer ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid(String uuid)
methods.description: Retrieves a Location object based on its UUID string.
